name: Grace Window
author: CoolJam
description: Reopen recently closed window, including its content with SUPER+SHIFT+W. The plugin rebinds SUPER+W to move the focused window silently to workspace 10 with a one-minute reopen grace period until it gets closed for real. You can configure the keybindings, hidden window look, grace period, … (see README for more)! Disabling or uninstalling the plugin via omarchy's plugin system removes its managed block from "~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua" automatically to restore your previous keybindings.
